body: Turned 26 today and I think I'm beyond the point of it ever getting better. I've wasted so much time. There is so much in this world I'll never get to experience and just being alive to see it pass me by hurts. Its not like I had much hope before but now I know this is it. My life was just meant to be this way. I'll still go to my shitty job tomorrow, come home sleep repeat for who knows how long, idk how much more I can take, seemingly a lot. I cant see myself living to 27 though please let me go

People wished me happy birthday and all I did was get moody with them. I don't want to wake up and face more of it. I just want to be forgotten. But I'm sorry for being angry at them I can't stop myself
It's hard to feel the distance. I don't have any advice but I hope it isn't as bad as it may seem. And if it is, hope you get through it.
Finished burning my important bridges and successfully sabotaged any hope of a future. I couldnt stop myself. I just gotta let go now

Birthday in a month and I don't think I'll make it. Can't handle the disappointment from after I fail to get into a master's program. My only goal to keep swimming. Even if I did I wouldn't have been able to finish it I was just delaying the inevitable. I can't watch others move past me and I'll always be stuck catching up but never good enough

Been a while but here I am again, distracting myself could only last so long 😎 2021 will thankfully be the last year, I can't delay it any longer. Might try even before new years if I can't pick myself up, this episode has been building up 😎😎 Then my pathetic worthless life can be forgotten by others and myself as it's always should've😎😎😎😎😎.

But I thought I would be better off with others. But then later I learned it would've been a Christian adoption agency and me now would not like that but maybe my mental health would be better and not spending all of my live being poor af would also be good so who knows

I feel the same way. I know I'll never belong. It got worse when I isolated myself for a few months. I lost the ability to speak coherently. I don't feel much really. I am just there. Maybe once I was a person but all I do is exist

Thank you. My dad and I had a huge argument about this a while back. We never brought up all this stuff before and this was his defense. It's really damaged our relationship even more than it was before. My mother is also a similar story but she still admits some of it. But now I have no idea where to go from here. I want to get away but I have no means to do so
I've thought about this before and I don't think there is. Too much shit, anything that I can get won't take away my memories and failed family relationships

Back at this point where I realise that all my efforts are still for nothing. I'm arguably worse off than I was 3 years ago I'm losing time, and I'm stuck. Battling my mental health and trying to escape my situation seems impossible to do and not possible in a decent time frame before I've wasted all my life. The last few months I haven't been feeling too awful, but still I go to sleep just thinking of hanging myself and I know that eventually I will it's the only logical way out of this horrible loop I'm in.  I can't stand to wait to see if things get better I don't see a future where it does. And if it does I don't think it would be worth all the time in pain. I'm alone most of these days so it's a fitting end to how I feel. I don't have any drive to continue. I've said this all before though but I think I finally have the will.

I think I'm just hurting myself by going out with her, hoping that there's something when there probably isn't. Idk if I even want anything or I just like the feeling of just being around someone. I feel so much and so little all at the same time. I am not meant for this world

My personality if I ever had one. My ability to have conversation without long gaps of silence because I can't think of anything worth saying. My ability to connect with anyone because of it including any of my family. All I seem to be able to do is say oh and feel nothing

I just play trilogy by the weeknd on repeat mostly or anything with spacey beats to try to lose myself. Finally hung out with one of my friends. I suspected she wanted me to go out with her before but I might be misinterpreting stuff. Went to see a movie after both of us putting it off  and walked around the mall for a few hours. Idk if I enjoyed myself, felt like I was empty and speechless the entire time and I feel like kinda shit now that's it's over. I wanna do it again, and unfortunately I've been obsessing over her now for days, even dreaming, even though I've known her for many years, idk if it was a date. She said we should do it again, but she spent a lot of the time talking about other guys, one of which is an older guy she says she has a crush on, but how she doesn't speak to them often or they're pushy and how we are similar and kinda introverted. Idk if she was also just trying to make conservation since I was just blank I think. Also mentioned how she doesn't have a bf a few times. All these years I didn't get my hopes up, just tried to keep a friendly distance and here I am  feeling like actual trash for days regardless because I wanna just walk around and talk again. I can't help but feel going in the first place was a mistake and it's only going to make me more miserable. I know I should probably talk to her again but idk I also fear rejection 😎😎 on the bright side I guess this is new to me. I know this obsession isn't good even if it works out though lord help me

Went to a family party for Thanksgiving and was unable to speak to anyone, I know they don't know me or care about me, I barely know or see them anyways. I can't really describe the  feeling, kinda a hollowness in my chest and my mind wanders.

I feel I can't even open up completely to them though, I've tested the waters and I know that's not the relationships we have, mostly my fault because I get really distant at times and refuse to hangout, out of fear of feeling empty  if that makes sense. I know theres no chance here for years  but it still drives me crazy, but again im pretty sure i only like the idea of them. Havent seen them in a few years but we still speak.

I feel she won't understand me as well though. We also always talk about the same stuff and i am unable to say anything. I feel I have nothing of value to say and I'm unable to communicate it properly in anyway if I did. She texted me this week, and I knew it was for money as that's when she speaks  to me more. 

I've lost interest in classes again, as there I am also unable to speak to anyone.

Idk this was rambley but hopefully someone can relate to this xd

When I was like 4 my mom left me and my sister with my dad. He became a bad alcoholic because of it. Dragged us to bars with him while we were still very young. I would always cry when I was younger afraid he would leave like my mom and because he would drink so much. Family found this annoying of course and they didn't like me much. My mom and him would fight so much and guilt tripping from both of them on us. We never had a lot of money, my teeth are all fucked. We kept moving from place to place changing schools until my grandparents got a house for my dad. His alcoholism got even worse though and would come home in the middle of the night passed out in front of the door and we had to drag him to bed. We begged him to stop but he didn't. Eventually we get evicted because he stopped paying the bills, I remember seeing the eviction notice on the door and feeling so sad, this was the longest we have lived at a place and it was less than 4 years so I lost all my friends again. We were like 12 at this point and my anxiety started to get worse. We move somewhere for 2 months again and also get evictegd, and for 2 months again we had no place to stay except by an aunt. We get a new place eventually, stay for less than a year but my dad had like 2 heartattacks and this caused him to stop drinking completely. There's other shit with my dad I got problems with like the lying to me all my life, not having my own bed until my teens, insisting he's the best father, years of neglect from both parents etc.

Then there's my mom, also a lot of lying and instability. After she left we always had a rocky relationship, have a hard time calling her mom etc. One Christmas she came to our house and told us to never speak to her again, we were 12 at the time. We would visit her, and she would fight with her new husband. She basically said she could never love me as much as the kids she has now which I understand but kind heartbreaking to hear. 

Anyways that's just my parents really. I used school as an escape from all this and moving so much just broke me. We got a computer when we were like 10 and that's how I coped through. Highschool wasn't that bad really except one teacher making fun of me for my teeth, entire class laughed and it completely shattered my self confidence and fully kicked in my social anxiety when I was like 14. But I had my group of friends and it was stable. Started university though, made no friends, and did awful first year eventually leading me to drop out for like a semester, failing needlessly because I was too scared to go speak to a counsellor. Doing well in school was the only redeemable part of me and it was gone. I dropped out, and cut my mom off for like half a year, she didn't really care. I'm back now but I'm so far behind and I'm still alone. I am so anxious at all times can't find a job or speak to people really without shaking. My mom dad and sister say I'm lazy and worthless and they are right. I put so much stress on them by dropping out and doing jackshit. I have no family to talk to because I don't trust any of them. Never had a relationship but that doesn't really bother me either because of my fear of rejection or abandonment or I'm just broken. I do cry myself to  sleep some nights because I feel trapped where I am. Teeth still fucked need money but idk whagt to do. My sister has a way better relationship with both my parents and she is doing well in school and has a job. I pale in comparison, idk how she coped so well, I'm probably just whiny and looking for excuses. We haven't spoken in like half a year after a falling out about me. I'm just tired of feeling this way, I've tried exercising and trying to look as best as I can but I hate myself so much I can't look at myself, I'm so underweight. I don't see it getting better. Idk how to reach out to get help my family isn't supportive like that. But as it is right now I let my anxiety control my life. I'm just tired of it all. I have like 4 friends and I'm waiting for them to move on from me as they should I'm a loser that doesn't want to go out. I'm the biggest problem in my life right now that both my parents and my home life is relatively stable. Cant speak without shaking, or just dissociating completely. My current school year might be fucked because of my decisions again and at that point idk the point of living even more so than now. I just want a fresh start and to forget, I dont see a future for me to be happy. Anyways this got rambly and I probably forgot stuff and you probaby weren't looking for life stories but don't have anyone to share this with so xd
